tracklist: You Need to Cut Your Hair
Two Blokes and a Double Bass

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (11 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/Ed-Sheeran-Want-Some/release/6634760, https://www.herbmusic.net/album/ed-sheeran-want-some%3f-33298. 2007 independent release (Sheeran Lock). Discogs formats it as a CD 'Album', others as an EP. 11 tracks on both Discogs (r6634760) and herbmusic.net/musify. Track 11 'I Can't Spell' contains a hidden track: an acoustic version of 'You Break Me'. 'Move On' features Alonestar. THIS IS THE SAME RELEASE as the duplicate entry 'Want Some?' - same artist, same year, same tracklist; one is a year-suffixed duplicate row.
